name: TAIFEX same-venue global-control design for NIGHT_PRE_SCAN
coreFinding: TAIFEX itself lists TX/MTX/TMF together with S&P 500, Nasdaq-100 and PHLX Semiconductor Sector futures in the 15:00-05:00 after-hours session. This creates a same-venue candidate control set for the 15:00-18:10 Taiwan night residual, reducing source-clock and cross-provider mismatch relative to an external-feed-first design.
sameVenueAdvantages: potentially simpler PIT capture and replay lineage
avoids assuming an external vendor timestamp is directly comparable before latency is proven
nonEquivalenceGuards: TAIFEX-listed U.S. index futures are not automatically identical in liquidity, price discovery, basis or contract economics to CME/other home-market contracts.
Same venue does not prove sufficient liquidity; stale/zero-volume controls remain UNKNOWN, never zero-return evidence.
The PHLX semiconductor futures control may be especially sparse; it must earn inclusion by coverage/quote-quality evidence.
Do not combine broad, tech and semiconductor controls as three independent votes; test nested incremental residualization.
No result may be called U.S.-information causality without checking common-news simultaneity and Taiwan-specific absorption.

sourceFacts.session: TAIFEX official trading-scheme page lists TX, Mini-TX, Micro-TX, S&P 500, Nasdaq-100 and PHLX Semiconductor Sector futures in 15:00-05:00 after-hours trading.
sourceFacts.txExpiryGuard: TX/MTX/TMF expiring delivery-month contract has no after-hours session on its last trading day.
sourceFacts.historicalTrades: TAIFEX public website provides individual trades for the past 30 trading days; older history requires application/purchase.

outcomeBlindReadinessPilot.acceptanceRule: Do not freeze numeric thresholds from return outcomes. First characterize distributions across independent dates; preregister quality thresholds before any outcome join.

residualLadder: TX residual vs TAIFEX S&P 500 future
add TAIFEX Nasdaq-100 future only if incremental and sufficiently liquid
add TAIFEX PHLX Semiconductor future only if incremental and sufficiently liquid
external/home-market futures are challenger sources after latency/entitlement alignment, not assumed ground truth
falsification: same-venue controls too illiquid/stale to represent global state
apparent value exists only on crisis/event dates
simple broad control performs as well as multi-control model
TX raw move performs as well as residual, making complexity redundant

maturityDecision.promotion: No promotion. L3 requires actual PIT/replay feasibility and independent-date evidence; L4 requires prospective/OOS evidence.

exactNextContinuation: Use recent TAIFEX transaction files only for outcome-blind parser/coverage QA of TX + TAIFEX S&P500/Nasdaq100/PHLX-semiconductor controls.
Freeze stale/liquidity eligibility thresholds before any Taiwan outcome join.
Then prospectively capture the same 15:00-18:10 set under the unified receipt envelope.
Compare same-venue controls with external/home-market controls only after source latency and entitlement are proven.
